units.source_text: 次日，薰大将只派两三个平素亲信而不甚重要的家臣护送小君，

en.t: The next day, General Kaoru sent only two or three trusted but relatively minor retainers to escort Kogimi,

units.source_text: 又添加一个从前常赴宇治送信的随从人员。

en.t: and added one attendant who had often gone to Uji in the past to deliver messages.

units.source_text: 乘人不听见的时候，他唤小君到面前来，对他说道：

en.t: When no one else could hear, he called Kogimi before him and said:

units.source_text: “你还记得你那姐姐的面貌么？

en.t: Do you still remember what that elder sister of yours looked like?

units.source_text: 人家都以为她现已不在世间了，其实她的确还活着呢。

en.t: Everyone thinks she is no longer in this world, but in truth she is certainly still alive.

units.source_text: 我不要叫外人知道，单派你前往探访。

en.t: I do not want outsiders to know, so I am sending only you to go and look into it.

units.source_text: 你母亲也暂时勿使她知道。

en.t: Do not let your mother know for the time being either.

units.source_text: 因为告诉了她，她惊讶喧哗起来，反而使得不该知道的人都知道了。

en.t: For if she is told, she will be startled and make a commotion, and then even people who should not know will find out.

units.source_text: 我看见你母亲悲伤，甚是可怜，所以去把她找寻出来。”

en.t: Seeing your mother grieve seemed so pitiful to me that I went and found her out.

units.source_text: 小君还是一个童子，但也知道自己兄弟姐妹虽多，却没有一人赶得上这姐姐的美貌，所以一向很爱慕她。

en.t: Kogimi was still a child, but he knew that although he had many brothers and sisters, not one could match this sister's beauty, and so he had always adored her.

units.source_text: 后来闻知她死去，他的童心中一直十分悲伤。

en.t: Later, when he heard that she had died, his childish heart had remained deeply sad.

units.source_text: 现在听了薰大将这番话，不胜欣喜，流下泪来。

en.t: Now, hearing these words from General Kaoru, he was overcome with joy and began to shed tears.

units.source_text: 他怕难为情，为欲掩羞，故意大声答应：“是，是！”

en.t: Afraid of feeling embarrassed and trying to hide his shyness, he deliberately answered loudly, Yes, yes!
